messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a spike in tenant quota rejections right after the TS SDK 0.9.2 rollout. Looks tied to the routing header rename.

maya: Console shows a bunch of requests landing with no route attribution, so quota accounting falls back to global token bucket. Tenants hit rate limits.

dan: Oof. Which header changed?

maya: TS SDK now emits `x-redwood-route-priority` -> `x-rd-route-weight` (shortened). Server-side console mapping still expects the old key.

sophia: Is the SDK sending both during a grace period?

maya: No, 0.9.2 dropped the old key entirely to reduce header size for mobile customers.

rafael: We're seeing this in staging logs too. Example from edge-proxy: ```INFO route-mapper: missing key x-redwood-route-priority, fallback used; tenant=acct-42 req=ghj123```

julie: That fallback is intentional but should be rare; this patch made it common. Severity: some customers are getting throttled.

dan: Can we add a quick shim in the route-mapper to read the new header name and populate the old field for console attribution? Low-risk hotfix.

sophia: Yes — short-term shim + add backwards-compatible header acceptance. We should also add a telemetry tag so we can measure how many requests only have the new header.

rafael: Agree. I can open a PR to route-mapper and edge-proxy. Will also emit a gauge `route_header_compat` (true|false) per request for dashboards.

maya: P0? Customers impacted but not an outage. Recommend hotfix to 1) shim, 2) roll console mapping change to accept new key, 3) quick SDK patch to send both headers for one release.

julie: On the SDK side, sending both headers (old + new) is tiny overhead and avoids churn. We should publish a patch 0.9.3 with dual-write and a note in changelog.

dan: Roll plan: deploy shim to edge-proxy (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%), console mapping change behind feature flag (enable for internal tenants first), and coordinate SDK patch release.

deploy-bot: deploy started: route-mapper/shim v2026.03.23-canary -> 10% traffic (link: https://deploys/redeployer/12345) :rocket:

maya: Thanks. For dashboards — can we add a one-line tooltip on the Quotas dashboard explaining fallback attribution? Non-obvious why a tenant suddenly uses global bucket.

sophia: I'll file a small UX ticket for console (console-team) and add a temporary banner for affected tenants.

rafael: PR opened: https://git/repo/route-mapper/pull/214 (adds header shim + metric). Monitoring: alerted on quota-rejection rate for top 20 tenants.

julie: I'll cut SDK 0.9.3 after the shim is live and the metric shows <1% new-only header traffic. ETA for cut: 2h after canary success.

maya: Sounds good. Postmortem action: we need a checklist for header renames that includes: SDK dual-write grace, console mapping compatibility, and a rollout telemetry flag.

dan: Noted. Also add an SDK deprecation notice to changelog for 2 releases, and a console config to map header aliases.

maya: Closing loop — ping me in #incidents if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
